source: Actual plugin in Chromium; simulated backend, not live Spotify

results.name: Default FX: no effects toggle, painted ring, all hardware hover/focus/press treatments
Lyrics: loading, missing, instrumental, network error/retry and no-track states are distinct
Pane keeps authoritative playback fresh when footer is absent
Account controls open connection inside screen when Spotify account is disconnected
Transport and account buttons dispatch exact actions and synchronize confirmed states
Screen tabs have keyboard selection and accurately expose selection while settings are open
Lyrics fit narrow and normal screens, expose active line, and permit manual reading
Settings and taste palette controls: persistence, curation, prompt selection and hover inventory
Failed slider commands restore confirmed values and show an in-player error
Playlist and search errors are not falsely reported as empty results
View controls sit on top chrome rather than consuming the display
Like response cannot overwrite the next song state
Unavailable Liked Songs states and failed writes are honest and recoverable
Top controls and their finish stay inset; side icons are consistently legible
Settings keeps text controls plus exactly one reference-layout picker and fully fits without scrolling
Song play automatically paints authoritative liked/unliked state without a heart click
Side rings clear the chrome bevel and screen with mirrored, evenly spaced rows
